title: Appraisal Order Cancellation Authority and Hold Limit
content:
**Appraisal Order cancellation and hold limit.**

(a) Only the borrower can cancel an order they are paying for.
(b) The system cancels an order when the Mortgage Loan File is withdrawn, denied or closed, and when the order has been on hold for more than the report type's hold limit in calendar days.
(c) A completed or delivered report is never cancelled; it stays on file.
(d) Cancellation stamps the closed date, and charges are refunded under the fee refund rules according to the stage the order reached.

| Situation | Cancelled? | By whom |
|---|---|---|
| Borrower paying for the order asks to cancel an assigned order | Yes | The borrower |
| Loan file withdrawn, denied or closed | Yes | The system |
| Order on hold longer than the hold limit | Yes | The system |
| Report already completed or delivered | No — it stays on file | — |

*Hold limit, hypothetical (30-day limit):* an order on hold for 30 calendar days has not exceeded the limit; at 31 days it has, and the system cancels it.
